After completing this session, you will be able to:

-   Practice adding error messages to functions
<!-- -   Practice deploying a package and organizing custom functions within it -->

## Overview

In this practice session you will write, test, and document your own R functions.  You will start with a warm-up, then write functions that use conditionals, and finally add informative error and warning messages to your functions.  You will finish by saving your work with the Git and GitHub workflow.
